column1: # Hebrew (he) rows of the Fonts panel's words, for an app's shared catalog.
# Format: context<TAB>source<TAB>translation; @id rows name a word by its id, @plural rows list the locale's plural forms.
# Style and weight names (Regular, Bold, Italic), licence names and product names stay in English.
# Commands (buttons, links, menu items) use the gender-neutral infinitive (להתקין, להסיר). Instructions that are not
# commands use יש ל… or אפשר ל…. Placeholders stay as written.
# Plural forms are one|two|other: 1 is singular, 2 and every other count (including 11 and multiples of 10) are plural.
